market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham possess a squad far stronger than typical relegation candidates, with players like Jarrod Bowen and Lucas Paqueta. Historical data shows even struggling clubs of similar stature have <20% relegation probability in a 20-team league. The market's 34.5% likely overreacts to recent poor form.
evidence_points: Squad quality (e.g., Transfermarkt valuation ~€450M, 10th in PL)
Only 3/20 teams relegated each season; current bottom-three are significantly weaker.
FiveThirtyEight model assigns West Ham ~15% relegation risk for 2024-25, and future season should be similar barring major changes.
